sentences.text:
Court No. - 71 Case :- APPLICATION U/S 482 No. - 8403 of 2023 Applicant :- Nisar And 8 Others Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 2 Others Counsel for Applicant :- Jagdish Prasad Mishra Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Samit Gopal,J.
2. Supplementary affidavit dated 18.04.2023 filed today by learned counsel for the applicants is taken on record.

3. Heard Sri Geetam Singh, Advocate holding brief of Sri Jagdish Prasad Mishra, learned counsel for the applicants, Sri Rajesh Tiwari, learned counsel appears on behalf opposite party no.2 and 3 who has filed his vakalatnama along with counter affidavit today in Court which is taken on record, Sri U.P. Singh, learned counsel for the State and perused the records.
4.

The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicants Nisar, Afsana,
Shakil, Idrish, Shamo, Imran Urf Parvez, Rizwan, Israr and Irfan Urf Lalli with the prayer to allow Nisar And 8 Others vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 20 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/150399148/
1 this application and quash the charge sheet No. 254 of 2022 dated 23.09.2022 as well as cognizance/summoning order dated 20.10.2022 and also quash the further proceeding of Case No.
10341/09 of 2022 (State Vs. Nisar and others), under Sections 498-A, 323, 506 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P.
Act against applicant no.1 to 5 and under Sections 498-A, 354, 323, 376-D, 506 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act agaisnt applicant no. 6 to 9, Police Station Thanabhawan, District Shamli arising out of Case Crime No. 259 of 2022 on the basis of compromise, pending in the court of Civil Judge (J.D.)/Judicial Magistrate, Shamli, and with the further prayer to stay the further proceedings of aforesaid case,
during pendency of this application.

sentences.text: 5. Learned counsel for the applicants states that vide order dated 15.03.2023 an order was passed by this Court in which the compromise between the parties were directed to be verified by the court concerned.

6. As per office report dated 19.04.2023, a report of concerned trial court has been received stating therein that in compliance of the said order dated 15.03.2023 the settlement deed was verified in presence of both the parties.
The report is annexed with the order sheet.

The same is mentioned in the said supplementary affidavit also dated 18.04.2023.
7.

The law with regards to quashing of a case on the basis of settlement arrived between the parties,
is well settled.

The Apex Court in the cases of (1) B.S. Joshi and others Vs. State of Haryana and another: (2003)4 SCC 675; (2) Nikhil Merchant Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation : (2008) 9 SCC 677; (3) Manoj Sharma Vs. State and others: ( 2008) 16 SCC 1; (4) Gian Singh Vs. State of Punjab:
(2012) 10 SCC 303; (5) Shaifullah and others Vs. State of U.P. And another: 2013 (83) ACC 278 and (6) Parbatbhai Ahir@Parbatbhai @ Bhimsinbhai Karmur and others Vs. State of Gujarat and another: (2017) 9 SCC 641 has held that the cases in which the parties have settled their grievances can be quashed.
